messages:
emily: FYI PR #10002 updates the migration guide for KMS onboarding. One example still contains a key-like placeholder that CI link-check flagged. Need sec + legal quick review before merging.

ci-bot: Docs preview for PR 10002: https://docs-preview.internal/preview/10002 — build: passed, link-check: failed (1 broken link). Files changed: docs/migration/kms-onboarding.md

tom: I pushed a small cleanup branch (10002-cleanup) that replaces the literal-looking token with a placeholder. Question: should we show process.env or a SecretManager.get call?

nina: Security: prefer SecretManager invocation pattern so readers don't assume env-only. Also file a redaction ticket for any doc that exposed key-like strings even if fake. Creating sec-221 now.

sec-bot: sec-221 created: docs redaction request for PR 10002. Assigned: nina. Policy: replace secrets with REPLACE_WITH_SECRET_MANAGER or use client.get('kms_key').

emily: Here was the original problematic snippet:
```bash
# BAD: looks like a key in docs
export KMS_KEY=pk_live_9f8e7d6c5b4a3
# usage...
```

emily: Proposed replacement in the PR:
```javascript
// GOOD: reference a secret manager client or env var injected by CI
const kmsKey = await secretManager.get('projects/myproj/secrets/KMS_KEY/versions/latest');
// do not paste secrets in repo
```

tom: That JS snippet is great. Please add a 1-line callout at the top: "Do not include real secrets in docs; use Secret Manager or CI-injected env vars." Also update contributor guide link.

legal-bot: Legal: standing request — if docs mention key formats (e.g., pk_live_) avoid realistic prefixes. Replace with GENERIC_KEY or REPLACED_SECRET. No regulatory flags on content otherwise.

nina: I reviewed the patch and left a tiny nit: show both patterns (SecretManager + env) in one compact example so readers can pick their workflow. Also removed the problematic anchor that CI flagged.

ci-bot: Preview updated: https://docs-preview.internal/preview/10002 — build: succeeded, link-check: passed.

emily: Thanks. Planning to merge in the docs merge window today (10-11am PT). I can merge at ~10:12am PT unless someone wants a different time.

tom: OK by me. I'll watch the merge and rollout steps.

nina: Security approves after replacement and ticket sec-221 will be closed once merged.

legal-bot: Legal sign-off: approved.

emily: Merged at 10:13am PT. Closing sec-221 and adding a small note to the contributor guide about placeholder conventions (REPLACED_SECRET / SecretManager examples). Thanks all!
